Matins · Monday, 26 October 2026

St. Evaristus, Pope and Martyr

S. Evaristi Papæ et Martyris · Simplex

Lesson

Having finished his testimony, he was buried upon the Vatican, hard by the grave of the Prince of the Apostles, upon the 26th day of October, (in the year of our Lord 112.)

℟. For he had his foundation upon a strong rock.

℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

℟. For he had his foundation upon a strong rock.
